retrievalProfile.description: A high-key, contemplative studio portrait featuring a subject with clasped hands near the face, utilizing wide-tracked extended sans-serif typography in the lower third.
triggerTerms: high-key studio lighting with clasped hands
excludeWhen: gritty or low-fidelity textures are requested
serif or script typography is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, high-contrast studio photograph of a man in a white shirt with his hands clasped in front of his face, set against a neutral light background with clean, modern typography positioned across the lower torso area.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's hands as the central focal point
High-key white clothing against a light grey background
Typography anchored to the horizontal line of the shirt cuffs
Deep shadows on the face contrasting with bright highlights on the hands

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered and tightly cropped from the chest up, filling the majority of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The interlocking fingers of the clasped hands serve as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the hands, moves down to the typography, and then up to the subject's partially obscured face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily in the upper left and right corners behind the subject.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, low saturation palette with high contrast between light and shadow.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to one primary accent color

composition.position: Lower right quadrant, below primary text
composition.relationshipToImage: Aligned with the bottom edge of the primary text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Same typeface family with color contrast for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Horizontal alignment across the lower third

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, geometric, late-80s tech-influenced aesthetic.
Provides the necessary horizontal expansion and clean lines.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key studio portrait of a man in a white dress shirt with French cuffs, hands clasped together near his chin, looking down. Use a neutral light grey background with soft but directional lighting creating deep shadows on the face.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of text in an extended sans-serif font like Eurostile. The top line should be black, left-aligned in the lower-left. The second line should be red, right-aligned in the lower-right, slightly below the first line.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting high-key with deep shadows?
Are the hands the central focus?
Is the typography extended and wide-tracked?
Is the color palette primarily white, black, and red?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
Original artist name and album title
postGenerationChecks: Check for correct hand anatomy in the clasped gesture
Ensure text does not obscure critical facial features
Verify the extended width of the typography
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key studio portrait + clasped hands gesture + extended sans-serif typography with wide tracking.
